structured_output.what_is_happening: A "$merci" cult/PFP meme (@mercicult; site merciszn.fun says the token is on Pump.fun and pays people who call it out or use the cat PFP) set off a wave of at least 10 same-name tokens within about 40 minutes. This coin (CdzTir…) was launched on a Meteora virtual curve about 24 minutes after the earliest pump.fun "merci" (9NPmnD…pump, $943k h1 volume). It is a late copycat. Its volume ($400k on $80–90k mcap) and its 1,737 unique buyers vs 132 sellers come from flow spilling over between look-alike tickers, not from being the canonical coin.

narrative.description: The merci cult/PFP meme: 'merci means thank you, the token is the thank you'. It rewards people who make callouts and people who wear the cat PFP.
narrative.why_spreading: The mechanic incentivises callouts, and the launch of many same-name tokens shows trenches traders are chasing the name. I found no indexed organic discussion.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found. The project site points to Pump.fun, but this token is a Meteora virtual-curve launch with no DexScreener profile. The GeckoTerminal twitter field just holds a status URL, a common trick copycats use.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 9NPmnDgL39…pump (earliest, $273k mcap, $943k h1 vol, most likely canonical), 9UpKDi… ($307k), HE3sA1… ($167k), 3jRqZf…, CpG8dE… and several more.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 89 bundler wallets. Unique buyers (1,737) far outnumber sellers (132), a pattern common in bot/copy-trade flow. Image duplicate count is 5. No smart or KOL wallets, and only 2 GMGN page visits.
authenticity.uncertainty: The X post (402) and Telegram are inaccessible, so I could not verify the canonical CA.

structural_risks: RugCheck says 99.99% of LP is unlocked, but GMGN says lp_burn 1.0, so the data conflict
One holder has 80% (probably the Meteora pool/vault, unverified)

structured_output.counterargument: Spillover buying is heavy (784 unique buyers in 5 minutes) and the mcap is low at $80k. If the canonical coin runs, copycats often rise with it, and a 2x to $160k needs little money.
unknowns: Whether the 80% holder is the pool
Whether the LP is actually locked

source_coverage.notes: Time-limited. The X post returned 402. The web searches (contract and name) found nothing relevant. The site says Pump.fun and lists no CA.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, non-canonical Meteora copycat in a crowded wave of same-name tokens. Its price already fell 5% in the last 5 minutes. A runner is unlikely, and it risks bleeding out as attention settles on the canonical pump.fun token.
